tldr: Hi Robot is a hierarchical vision-language-action system that enables robots to follow complex open-ended instructions and incorporate real-time user feedback by decomposing reasoning into a high-level VLM policy and a low-level VLA policy.
contributions: A hierarchical interactive robot learning system (Hi Robot) using VLMs for both high-level reasoning and low-level task execution
A synthetic data generation scheme that produces plausible user prompts and robot utterances from labeled robot demonstration data to train the high-level policy
Evaluation across single-arm, dual-arm, and dual-arm mobile robot platforms on tasks including table bussing, sandwich making, and grocery shopping
Demonstrated superiority over flat VLA policies and API-based VLM approaches in both alignment with human intent and task success
methods: The system decomposes robotic control into a high-level VLM policy that interprets open-ended prompts and user feedback to produce intermediate language commands, and a low-level VLA policy (based on π0 finetuned PaliGemma-3B) that executes those commands as action chunks. The high-level policy runs at a lower frequency (every 1 second or upon new user interaction). Synthetic training data is generated by prompting a VLM with visual observations and skill labels to imagine plausible user prompts and robot responses. The high-level policy is trained with cross-entropy loss on synthetic and labeled data; the low-level policy uses a flow-matching objective.
results: Hi Robot surpasses prior approaches including flat VLA policies and API-based VLMs in both alignment with human intent and task success across three robotic platforms. The system handles tasks such as cleaning messy tables (placing dishes and utensils correctly, handling nuanced grasping), making sandwiches with dietary modifications, and grocery shopping with novel skill combinations. It successfully processes complex prompts and incorporates real-time situated feedback like 'that's not trash' due to visual grounding.
limitations: The paper text was truncated before presenting complete quantitative results. The hierarchical design introduces additional complexity with two models running at different rates, and high-level inference latency (~1 second) may limit responsiveness to fast-changing environments.
